slice_summary: Slice 6 (Settings & Auth) of the SPLIT / Alpine UI redesign cycle recomposes the Settings screen into the designed rule sections and rebuilds the auth screens as brand posters. Frontend only; no wire, event, prompt, or generated-code change is expected. PR-A Settings (depends on Slice 0 tokens/primitives and Slice 1 tab shell): THE PLAN section with a current-plan line composed client-side from GET /api/v1/plan/current (GeneratedAt, Macro.TotalWeeks, Macro.GoalDescription) rendered as 'Generated Jun 29, 2026 [MIDDLE DOT] 12 weeks [MIDDLE DOT] <goal>', a REGENERATE PLAN clay-outline button and the mono warning 'REPLACES YOUR CURRENT PLAN. THE COACH STARTS FRESH FROM YOUR LOG BOOK.'; the regenerate dialog keeps its 500-character intent textarea and counter, is restyled per design sheet 5h, and adopts the Slice 0 BuildingPlanSurface while regeneration is in flight (today the dialog closes and refetches; this is net-new state wiring); the dead 'View previous plan' placeholder is deleted; APPEARANCE becomes a DARK / LIGHT / SYSTEM SegmentedControl over the existing theme wiring; UNITS becomes a KILOMETERS / MILES SegmentedControl over the existing settings API wiring; ACCOUNT is net-new behavior: 'SIGNED IN AS <email>' plus a SIGN OUT secondary button that calls the existing never-called useLogoutMutation (POST /api/v1/auth/logout), dispatches the logged-out action, posts the cross-tab logout broadcast (the receiver already exists), and calls the RTK api util resetApiState() to purge every per-user cache (DEC-089 D8, the pulled-forward cross-account cache-leak follow-up, declined PR #174), landing on login through the existing guards; footer mono 'SPLIT 0.9.0 [EM DASH] MVP' from a build-time constant derived from the frontend package version (no backend endpoint). PR-B Auth (depends on Slice 0 only): sign-in poster (SPLIT/ 58px wordmark, 64px-wide 2px rule, mono tagline 'THE PLAN ADAPTS. YOU DO THE WORK.', EMAIL and PASSWORD 48px fields, a password visibility eye toggle (net-new behavior), SIGN IN primary, then 'First run here? CREATE ACCOUNT [ARROW]'); register mirrors it with a START HERE heading and the password-rules helper rendered in mono; vertical room stays reserved under the primary button for an OAuth fast-follow and nothing else is built for it. Existing Zod schemas, ProblemDetails error mapping, flows, form ARIA wiring and role=alert messages are preserved contracts. Quality requirements: sign-out gets real tests (mutation call, broadcast reaching a second tab, resetApiState purge asserted by a previously cached query refetching, guard redirect); auth e2e journeys realigned; the regenerate 500-character counter pinned unchanged. Non-negotiables: semantic tokens only, 44px hit targets, 2px clay focus ring, motion-reduce pairing on every animation, dual-theme rendering, AA contrast via check-contrast.
